archive_notes: The public WordPress media endpoint reports 359 records, but unauthenticated pagination exposed 276; 275 files downloaded and media ID 9655 returned 404.

The nine public WPDM entries yielded seven PDF files. Two entries returned HTML pages stating that the Building Code 2006 package has no attached file and the September 2022 price index file was not found.
The WordPress REST API post inventory includes large volumes of unrelated betting/casino SEO spam and demo/commerce content. These were not treated as JBCC institutional source copy.

On 9 October 2026, 17 original-size files referenced by live institutional pages were added from page HTML: eight board portraits and nine constituent-body logos. They are among the media records hidden from the anonymous API. The remaining hidden records are not referenced by the institutional pages checked.
